♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 WAA DIYAAR! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions oo leh **Your script** iyo **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, iyo **Flex Studio (Beta)** oo marka hore la soo dejiyo, kuna weydiinaya kahor inta aan la rakibin.

*(Ku rakib noocaaga hadda jira dushiisa, kadibna hal mar dib u kici After Effects.)*

♦️ **Cusub: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Qaabka **Map desk**, raadinta meelaha iyadoo aan internet loo baahnayn, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route iyo kuwo kale), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, qaabab khariidad oo bilaash ah iyo **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Qalabkiisa dheeraadka ah (isku-xidhka tooska ah, qaababka, calaamadaha, 3D, Finalize) hadda si dhab ah ayay ugu shaqeeyaan gudaha After Effects.

♦️ **Waxa cusub ee AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, wuxuu isticmaalaa kiredhitka Flex AI) waa matoorka lagu taliyay, oo hal mar ayaa loo doortay qof walba. Mar kale dooro Whisper si aad bilaash ugu samayso qoraal-hoosaadyo kombiyuutarkaaga (Translate To wuxuu u baahan yahay Whisper). Marka server-ku mashquul yahay, wuxuu ku tusaa booskaaga safka.
* **Your script**: qoraal-hoosaadyadu waxay qaataan higaadda iyo erayada qoraalkaaga meel kasta oo aad erayadaas ku tidhi.
* Soo-saarka **Editable template**: qoraal-hoosaadyo ah lakabyo template ah oo aad qaabkooda ku beddeli karto Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Wax lama dooran, Source media-na waa madhan yahay? Wuxuu kuu soo jeedinayaa **composition-ka oo dhan**. Isla codka wuxuu dib u isticmaalaa qoraalkiisii hore (transcript).

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** marka hore wuu soo dejiyaa, kadibna wuxuu weydiiyaa **Install / Not now**.
* Barnaamijka (2.0.0-beta.2): goobaha shaqada **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, furayaasha qalabka sida After Effects, muuqaalladu isla markiiba way furmaan, OPEN-na hadda wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa precomps iyo adjustment layers.

♦️ **La hagaajiyay**
* Saamaynta theme-ka ee ka maqnayd kombiyuutaro badan oo Windows ah way soo laabteen (way fududaadaan marka saamaynta animation-ka ee Windows la damiyo).

♦️ **Goob ikhtiyaari ah oo loogu talagalay ilaalinta laysanka**
* Hal mar oo keliya ayaa la weydiiyaa, waana ikhtiyaari: haddii aad doorato **No thanks**, wax walba way sii shaqaynayaan. Ka beddel **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Waxaa la hayaa 12 bilood, weligeed lama iibiyo, lamana wadaago marka laga reebo meesha sharcigu ku khasbo.

♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 WAA DIYAAR! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack wuxuu u guuray AutoCaptions** oo leh qaab eray kasta, qaabeyn, dhaqdhaqaaq iyo codad. **UN-NEST** iyo blend modes waxay ka shaqeeyaan Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** waa hal riix, **Flex Studio (Beta)**-na wuxuu muuqaalkaaga ka furaa guddiga (panel).

*(Ku rakib noocaaga hadda jira dushiisa, kadibna hal mar dib u kici Premiere Pro.)*

♦️ **Cusub: Qoraal-hoosaadyo dhaqdhaqaaq leh oo ku jira AutoCaptions**
* **Qaabka erayga**: sii eray kasta midabbo, far (font) iyo dhammeystir Flat, Shine ama Glow ah oo u gaar ah.
* **Qaabeynta safafka**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside iyo Line.
* **Dhaqdhaqaaq eray kasta** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake iyo kuwo kale) oo leh horudhac (preview), iyo weliba codadka **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Qaababka erayada iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa waxay u baahan yihiin soo-saarka **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, wuxuu isticmaalaa kiredhitka Flex AI) hadda waa matoorka lagu taliyay, oo hal mar ayaa loo doortay qof walba; dooro matoor Whisper ah si aad bilaash ugu samayso qoraal-hoosaadyo adigoo aan internet isticmaalin.
* **Your script** (qaabka Captions): qoraal-hoosaadyadu waxay qaataan erayada qoraalkaaga meesha aad erayadaas ku tidhi.
* Haddii aan waxba la dooran (kaarka Source oo madhan), wuxuu soo jeedinayaa **timeline-ka oo dhan**; qoraal-hoosaadyada waxaa lagu kaydiyaa meel u dhow mashruucaaga.

♦️ **Cusub: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** wuxuu muuqaalka ku raad-raacaa barnaamijka; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** wuxuu dib u soo celiyaa raad-raaca. Ma aadan rakibin? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** ayaa soo dejinaya, kadibna wuxuu weydiiyaa **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Waxa isbeddelay**
* **AUTO CUT** wuxuu falanqeeyaa muuqaalka la doortay oo hal riix ku jaraa. **Retakes** wuxuu qabtaa safafka dib loo bilaabay.
* **Audio Studio** hadda wuxuu leeyahay lix tab-hoosaad. **Library** hadda waxay ku jirtaa Nest Saver.

♦️ **La hagaajiyay**
* **UN-NEST** ee Premiere 26.5 (wuxuu diidi jiray nest kasta), iyo blend modes sida Screen oo dib ugu noqon jiray Normal (Premiere-ka Ingiriisiga ah).
* Calaamadda cas ee **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, horudhaca madow ee Caption Stack, iyo saamaynta theme-ka ee ka maqnayd kombiyuutaro badan oo Windows ah.

♦️ **Goob ikhtiyaari ah oo loogu talagalay ilaalinta laysanka**
* Hal mar oo keliya ayaa la weydiiyaa, waana ikhtiyaari: haddii aad doorato **No thanks**, wax walba way sii shaqaynayaan. Ka beddel **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Waxaa la hayaa 12 bilood, weligeed lama iibiyo, lamana wadaago marka laga reebo meesha sharcigu ku khasbo.
